flag.reason: Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy given by a new intra-arterial route (rule 6), but it is co-investigated with cetuximab in a single regimen and could instead be experimental_combination (candidate).

coder_notes: Single registered intervention covers both cetuximab and bevacizumab; split into two agent rows. Intra-arterial route (SIACI) for both agents. Population <22 years (stdAges CHILD, ADULT) with mixed gliomas including GBM and DIPG. 'H3 K27M' appears only in the conditions list, not as an eligibility requirement or in design/outcomes, so no biomarker row was recorded. If bevacizumab is judged experimental_combination, cetuximab role would become experimental_combination too.
